exposure: sublingual administration of carboprost combined with oxytocin treatment (20IU oxytocin and small pot drip of 10IU oxytocin after delivery)
1mg of carboprost when the fetal head came out and then applied with intramuscular injection of 20IU oxytocin
cohort: 180 women with hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy
finding: Combination drug therapy (sublingual carboprost and oxytocin) during cesarean section is effective in preventing postpartum hemorrhage for women with hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy.
